candidateDirectShaping.scope: Direct fontkit.layout on original strings with authenticated supplied fonts, independently mapped to native glyph outlines. Not public PDF output or position parity.

42 canonical pairs agree by actual font object, embedded bytes and code, across pages. Computed floating position differences remain unchanged, including arithmetic artifacts.
General font-aware decomposition/reordering/composition, original-text preservation and public output qualification remain required. Plain NFC is not an authenticated replacement for HarfBuzz.
All 19 original gap families remain open.
